title: Lifecycle keys in the pod profile
description:
Add stage (idea, assignment, reporting, copywriting, illustration, typesetting, published, held, spiked, retired), type, section, format, rating (1 to 4 only; 5 refused), reviewedBy, reviewedOn, reviewedHash, spikedReason, heldReason to the pod profile with the same names as the cloud Item fields. A note with a stage builds into a site only at published; a note with no stage builds unless draft: true; a note may not carry both. pod check reports review is stale when reviewedHash no longer matches the body. Context generator updated. Kanbus stays the task board; a pod never reads issues. Can run beside slices 1-3. Depends on the local-pod epic (profile, pod check, pod load), not yet on this board.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Pod lifecycle keys (stage values checked; stage and draft together refused; a stale reviewedHash is reported).
- pod check prints one plain line that pod review keys are claims and not newsroom review.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
